in_english.long_meaning: Joanie is a variant of the feminine form of Joanne, derived from the Hebrew name איריל הוברירור, meaning 'God is gracious.' This name is also derived from the Greek name Ιόπανι, meaning 'God is gracious.' In Christian tradition, the name Joanie is associated with Saint Joan, a 15th-century French heroine who was canonized as a saint. The name Joanie is also associated with the virtue of graciousness, which is a key aspect of the Christian faith. In modern times, the name Joanie has become popular in many English-speaking countries, including the United States, Canada, and Australia. It is often given to girls born into Christian families, who are looking for a name that reflects their faith and values.
